_about: What a hand review of the open EU legislative procedures expected for J&T
Express Germany, written on 2026-09-11 before the body gate saw any of them.
These 14 were first built as input/eu_procedures.json, a collection watch-list.
That made collection client-specific - another client could not reuse the
corpus, and cutting a quiet procedure here would have removed it for everyone -
so collection now takes every legislative procedure and this file is only an
expectation to check the gate against. It decides nothing.
Chosen by reading the titles of the 145 open procedures with activity since
mid-2024 and keyword-scanning the 72 dormant ones; the procedures dropped in
that pass are not listed here, so this set measures recall, not precision.

rules.expected: relevant = a weekly J&T report could carry it. unsure = a horizontal rule that reaches J&T as it reaches any company, so either verdict is acceptable. A miss is a core or moderate procedure the gate calls irrelevant.
rules.tier: core = the file is about J&T's parcels. moderate = it binds J&T's customers' sellers or its delivery fleet. marginal = plausible but thin; included because collection is cheap and cutting early is worse than measuring.

procedures.name: EU customs reform: Union Customs Code, EU Customs Authority and data hub
procedures.why: Ends the 150-euro duty exemption and makes online platforms the deemed importer of the parcels J&T carries.

procedures.name: VAT for platforms facilitating distance sales of imported goods (IOSS, import VAT)
procedures.why: The VAT half of the customs package: who declares and pays import VAT on low-value e-commerce parcels.

procedures.name: EPR authorised representatives: batteries and packaging
procedures.why: Whether non-EU sellers shipping into the EU must appoint an EU representative for packaging and battery producer responsibility.

procedures.name: EPR authorised representatives: waste, WEEE and single-use plastics
procedures.why: The same duty for electronics and single-use plastics, the other goods Temu and Shein sellers ship.

procedures.name: Digital product compliance, amending the market surveillance regulation 765/2008
procedures.why: How imported goods show conformity and how market surveillance checks them.

procedures.name: Clean corporate vehicles
procedures.why: Zero-emission shares for company fleets would reach delivery fleets, but bind any company alike.

procedures.name: CO2 standards for new light duty vehicles (vans)
procedures.why: Supply and cost of last-mile delivery vans.

procedures.name: Single Market and Customs Programme 2028-2034
procedures.why: Funding for customs IT and controls; carries nothing about e-commerce controls by itself.

procedures.name: Digital product compliance, the directives
procedures.why: The directive half of 2025/0134(COD); mostly machinery, lifts and radio equipment.

procedures.name: Speed-limiter exemption for electric N2 trucks
procedures.why: Medium electric delivery trucks of 3.5 to 12 tonnes.

procedures.name: Weights and dimensions of heavy road vehicles
procedures.why: Line-haul trucks between hubs, usually subcontracted.

procedures.name: Electronic declaration of posted workers
procedures.why: Paperwork for cross-border staff of subcontractors.

procedures.name: ETS2 market stability reserve (buildings and road transport)
procedures.why: The carbon price on road fuel from ETS2, a delivery cost.

procedures.name: Digital Omnibus: GDPR and ePrivacy simplification
procedures.why: Data protection is one of the contract's six regulatory domains, and a carrier holds recipient data; cross-sector.
